newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Superconductor to test PCS filter.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Superconductor to test PCS filter.

text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp said on Wednesday that it will begin field trials in the first quarter of 1997 on a new wireless communications filter for PCS (personal communications system).

The product, called SpectrumMaster PCS, is designed to improve telephone call quality, increase network capacity and extend the cell range, therefore requiring fewer base stations and reducing costs for operators, ISC said.
ISC said the PCS product is based on the company's SpectrumMaster cellular filter line, but works with the PCS frequencies. ISC has already tested and received an order for its cellular filter.
